HIDDEN FALLS TERMINAL HARVEST AREA TROLL FISHERY

The Hidden Falls Terminal Harvest Area (THA) commercial salmon troll fishery will open for the harvest of salmon from 12:01 a.m., Wednesday, July 1, through 11:59 p.m., Sunday, September 20, 2026, unless closed by emergency order. Without a forecasted return of legal sized Chinook salmon for the troll fishery, the THA initial opening for troll gear is delayed until July 1.

The Hidden Falls THA (statistical area 112-22) includes waters of District 12 south of the latitude of South Point at 57°16.28′ N lat, north of 57°06.76′ N lat, and west of a line from a point offshore at 57°16.28′ N lat, 134°48.00′ W long, to a point offshore at 57°06.76′ N lat, 134°43.00′ W long, excluding the waters of Kelp Bay.

The waters of the Hidden Falls THA that are north and west of a line from ADF&G regulatory markers located at 57°13.17′ N lat, 134°51.86′ W long to 57°13.08′ N lat, 134°52.02′ W long and north of a line from 57°13.05′ N lat, 134°52.24′ W long to 57°13.06′ N lat, 134°52.20′ W long are closed to commercial salmon fishing (5 AAC 33.374[g]).

Chinook and chum salmon Beginning at 12:01 a.m., July 1, Chinook salmon may be retained and possessed in the Hidden Falls THA only during open Chinook salmon retention periods established for the summer troll fishery under 5 AAC 29.100(c). Additionally, effective July 1, the number of chum salmon permitted on board a troll vessel operating troll gear within the Hidden Falls THA or recorded on a fish ticket from the Hidden Falls THA, may not exceed the number of Chinook salmon on board the troll vessel or recorded on a fish ticket for that area (5 AAC 33.374[d]). Accordingly, chum salmon may only be retained in the summer troll fishery during an open Chinook salmon troll fishing period.

Coho salmon Coho salmon retention is permitted during open fishing periods in the THA from July 1 through September 20, unless closed by emergency order. During a season when the general summer troll season is extended in District 12, the Hidden Falls THA season will also be extended (5 AAC 33.374[e]).

Other salmon Pink and sockeye salmon retention is permitted during open THA fishing periods from July 1 through September 20, unless closed by emergency order.

The Emergency Order corresponding to this announcement is EO 1E0526.

Advisory Announcement web site: http://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=cfnews.main.
